sources.title: Piracy monthly report November 2024
sources.text: Duty crew on the ship underway spotted three robbers armed with guns and long knives inside the engine room. Alarm raised and VTIS notified. The Coast Guard escorted and boarded the ship for investigation. Engine spare parts were reported stolen.
